sections.title: Who we are
paras: MICEGO is operated by {{OPERATOR_LEGAL_NAME}} (trading as MatchGo), {{OPERATOR_ADDRESS}}, Republic of Korea (“MICEGO”, “we”). We are the controller of the personal data described in this notice.

This notice is for hotel and resort contacts who register with MICEGO or quote on requests, and for international visitors to our English pages. Organizers in Korea should read our Korean privacy policy (개인정보처리방침), which covers the same processing in more detail and prevails for organizer data.

paras: We do not store your IP address with feedback or contact messages. To limit abuse, we keep a short-lived, irreversibly transformed value derived from your IP address, and we store such a value (never the address itself) with each quote you submit or revise (see section 6).
The sample request page is a demo. Nothing you type there is transmitted or stored.

sections.title: Why we use it and our legal bases

list: To review your registration, send you matching MICE requests, receive your quotes and tell you the result — necessary to operate the partnership you asked to join.
To show your quote to the organizer in the comparison sheet and, if you are selected, to introduce you — necessary to operate the partnership.
To contact you about the partnership, pause or reinstate listings and keep the service secure — our legitimate interest in running a reliable marketplace.
To reply to feedback when you leave a reply email — your consent, which you give separately in the widget and can withdraw at any time.
To keep records the law requires — legal obligation.

sections.title: What we share, and with whom
paras: Organizers: when you submit a quote on a live request, your rates and terms appear in the comparison sent to that organizer, labelled only as Proposal A, B or C with your star rating, area, distance to the beach, size and whether you are chain-affiliated. Your property name and the contact details in your quote are disclosed to the organizer only if the organizer selects your proposal.

sections.title: International transfers
paras: MICEGO is based in the Republic of Korea, and our service providers may process data in the United States or other countries. We transfer data only as needed to run the service, under contracts that require the provider to protect it.

If you are in the European Economic Area, the United Kingdom or another country with transfer rules, we rely on the safeguards available for that transfer, such as standard contractual clauses, where required. Contact us for details. [legal review]

sections.title: Your rights
paras: Depending on the law that applies to you, you can ask to access, correct or delete your personal data, to restrict or object to its processing, to receive a copy in a portable format, and to withdraw consent at any time. Email {{PRIVACY_EMAIL}} from the address you registered, or include the reference code. We reply within 10 days where Korean law applies, and within the period your local law requires otherwise.
You can also complain to a data-protection authority, including the Korean Personal Information Protection Commission or the authority where you live or work.
Every invitation email contains an unsubscribe link. Selection results for quotes you already submitted are still sent after you unsubscribe.

sections.title: Cookies and browser storage
paras: We do not use cookies. If we introduce analytics or other cookies, we will update this notice first.
The bot check on our public forms (Cloudflare Turnstile, section 4) may briefly use a cookie or browser storage while it runs. [legal review]
Your browser stores the last mode you chose (Travel agencies / Hotels) in localStorage, and anything you are typing in the feedback widget in sessionStorage until you send it or close the tab.
Fonts and some scripts load from Google Fonts and jsDelivr, which receive connection data such as your IP address when a page loads.

sections.title: Security
paras: We encrypt data in transit (HTTPS), restrict access to operators who need it, log operator actions, and use hard-to-guess personal links for each invitation that are hidden from search engines. Please do not forward your invitation links.

sections.title: Organizer data you receive
paras: If you are selected, you receive the organizer's company name, contact name, email address and mobile number. Our Partner Terms (Articles 13–15) require you to use this data only for that booking, keep it secure and delete it when no longer needed.

sections.title: Children
paras: MICEGO is a business service and is not directed at children. We do not knowingly collect data from anyone under 14.

sections.title: Changes and contact
paras: This notice applies from {{EFFECTIVE_DATE}}. We post changes at least 7 days before they take effect, or 30 days before for material changes, and email registered partners.
